title: GENERATIVE AI IN HERITAGE PRACTICE: IMPROVING THE ACCESSIBILITY OF HERITAGE GUIDANCE

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative assessment of prompt responses to test the model's ability to output British English vocabulary and grammar, observing its default tendency to retain Americanisms.
Manual evaluation by a professional copyeditor using a 1-5 scale rubric to score text samples for cultural sensitivity, inclusivity, diversity, and equality based on organizational guidelines.
